reviews.title: Really nice PWM LED fans for the price.
reviews.comment: Really nice PWM LED fans for the price.  It's amazing how inexpensive these are for what you get, compared to the competing products out there.  Color is nice and spread out on the blades.  Fans are decently quiet at a limited speed.  I'd not hesitate to use these in other builds.
reviews.author: Nick K.

reviews.title: This are quiet, don't overthink it like I did
reviews.comment: Very good fans for the price. I'm easily annoyed with sounds, my case had some corsair fans which i thought were more premium than these but they had an annoying sound. You can buy fans that are 4x more expensive than these and people and reviews will say and show how much quieter they are but unless your is less than a foot from your ear and your room is dead quiet you won't notice the sound difference at all. These are quiet and a great price. I'd highly recommend at least trying these before purchasing expensive ones.
reviews.author: SmartShopper

reviews.title: Quality for the price
reviews.comment: Need I say anything about these fans ? There a standard for me in any build. One of the first things I do to any case I buy is rip out the fans and fit it with thermalright fans. There the best fans you can get without breaking the bank.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Works as Intended with Lots of Air Flow and the RGB Works Great!
reviews.comment: Pros: 140mm Fans push a lot of air Keeps my system cool RGB works and looks great with the MSI software They function silently Cons: None so far Would recommend
reviews.author: John Weaver

reviews.title: AMAZING for the price! Great RGB quality, looks great
reviews.comment: I was gifted the NZXT H9 Flow RGB case which came with 3-140mm fans on the front but no fans on the bottom. I decided to NOT spend $70 on NZXTs and instead get these bad boys. It was the right move! You can barely even tell the difference between the 2 different fan types. They practically look the same. The RGB quality is the same. This company is fantastic value. If I ever need 140mm fans again, i am getting these.
reviews.author: Anthony Cabrera
